The sandbox's write allowlist covers `$TMPDIR` and `/tmp/claude`, but not the root of `/tmp`, so this is the sandbox blocking the write. I did not retry it with the sandbox disabled, since you asked for the command, not for the sandbox to be bypassed.

If you want this probe to succeed, you can either run it yourself outside the sandbox, or use `/sandbox` to adjust the write restrictions. Otherwise, the same test works inside the sandbox with `touch "$TMPDIR/sandbox-probe.txt"`.
